actors.retained_burden: Cannot outsource the definition of work to a generic competency model.
Owns the architecture of the selection transaction.
Owns the claim that the generated score or report means anything.
Cannot hide the final judgment behind HR or the vendor.
Must learn from the policy it deploys, including what it made impossible to observe.
Participates in the record rather than serving only as raw assessment material.
Tests both discrimination risk and institutional monoculture.

control_question: When a hiring system changes a person’s available future, who must preserve the prediction, expose the role model and instrument, record accommodation and evidentiary conflicts, and reconcile the claim against later evidence?

controls.name: role_object_custody
controls.requirement: Preserve the actual work, operating conditions, success criteria, and failure criteria before selecting an instrument.

controls.name: instrument_and_threshold_custody
controls.requirement: Preserve the assessment vendor, instrument, version, norm group, constructs, sequence, time burden, threshold, and override rule.

controls.name: pretest_accommodation_disposition
controls.requirement: Document the disposition of an accommodation request before testing begins and distinguish the intended construct from disability-related limitations.

controls.name: signal_conflict_custody
controls.requirement: When interviews, work samples, and psychometric scores conflict, name which evidence prevailed, who decided, and why.

controls.name: candidate_evidence_return
controls.requirement: Return an intelligible candidate-facing report, correction path, and bounded appeal; substantial applicant labor should return compensation or useful evidence.

controls.name: exploration_budget
controls.requirement: Advance a controlled sample of near-threshold or model-uncertain candidates to richer review so false negatives can become observable.

controls.name: prediction_reconciliation_and_monoculture_audit
controls.requirement: Retain the prediction long enough to reconcile later evidence and audit shared-vendor concentration, drift, repeated rejection, and model revision.

non_entitlements: Later success does not prove the employer was obligated to hire the candidate for the original vacancy.
A rejection or missing explanation does not by itself establish illegality or discrimination.
A test score does not explain the role model, threshold, accommodation handling, or evidence weighting that produced an adverse decision.
Validation among selected employees does not estimate false negatives without some form of exploration or external outcome observation.
